tools.name: astrologos.run
tools.description: Run an Astrologos program and return a job id plus sync output when available.

tools.name: astrologos.job_status
tools.description: Read the current status for one owned Astrologos job.

tools.name: astrologos.job_result
tools.description: Read stored stdout and stderr for one completed owned Astrologos job.

tools.name: astrologos.abort_job
tools.description: Request cancellation for one owned Astrologos job.

tools.name: astrologos.usage
tools.description: Read current quota and reservation usage for the authenticated account.

tools.name: astrologos.validate_token
tools.description: Validate an Astrologos token without returning token material.

tools.name: astrologos.help
tools.description: Search or read Astrologos help without consuming execution quota.

tools.name: astrologos.get_settings_link
tools.description: Return the Astrologos web settings link for account settings, plans, and tokens.
